values.rank_only: retrieval impact only re-ranks VerifyOld candidates the history/learned gate already allowed; never opens the gate (default path byte-identical to pre-change behaviour)
values.joint_gate: retrieval impact may additionally open the VerifyOld gate when max_i(retrieval_activation_value_i) >= minimum_action_utility

verification_final_utility.existing_verification_utility_source: existing _verification_action formula (disease_gain with diagnostic_influence + reliability/decision terms - cost)
verification_final_utility.note: opened VerifyOld candidates still compete against best AskNew and Stop utility; verification is never forced

toy_smoke_config.corpus: tiny in-memory corpus (fever + myalgia snippets only)

forbidden: prediction path reading latent_state / true_wrongness / noise_type / true disease
